text:
alex: Quick check — I'm preparing a prod overlay change: we need to pin the model-server image to a digest and move a couple secret paths from SSM to SecretsManager before the promote. Planning to bundle kustomize + terraform changes in one PR. tagging @maria for release-gate concerns.
maria: ack. Do we pin by digest or immutable tag?
alex: digest. we had a bad rollout yesterday when `:latest` jumped. example kustomize snippet I'll apply to overlay:```yaml
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/redwood/model-server
    newName: ghcr.io/redwood/model-server
    newTag: "@sha256:3f8a9d..."
```
alex: For secrets, current SSM path is "/redwood/staging/model/key" and we need "/redwood/prod/model/key". Terraform will create a SecretsManager secret and a version, then a small migration job will copy values.
infra-ci: terraform plan (branch overlay-image-pin): shows 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy — resources: `aws_secretsmanager_secret.prod_model_key`, `aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.prod_model_key`. Plan is attached.
sam: Can you include a migration runbook in the PR? How do we do the copy safely (no downtime)?
alex: migration runbook: 1) create SecretsManager secret (empty) 2) run one-off pod that reads from SSM and writes to SecretsManager 3) update k8s overlay to use secretsmanager path 4) rollout canary at 10% then 50% then 100%. I'll add commands in PR.
linh: small caution: our app reads secret via CSI driver expecting name `redwood/prod/model_key` (no leading slash). make sure tf name matches. Also prefer setting `kms_key_id` to the prod KMS alias for encryption.
maria: For release gating: require infra-ci plan OK, k8s deploy checks (readiness probes), and canary metrics (error rate <0.5%, 95th p90 latency within 10% baseline) before promoting. Can we add health checks to overlay?
alex: yes — I'll add readinessProbe and a `rollingUpdate` annotation to the deployment overlay, plus a `canary` object for our rollout controller:```yaml
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxUnavailable: 0
    maxSurge: 10%
```
alex: terraform snippet I'll include in PR:```hcl
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "prod_model_key" {
  name       = "redwood/prod/model_key"
  kms_key_id = var.prod_kms_key_id
  tags = { env = "prod" team = "infra" }
}
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "prod_model_key_version" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.prod_model_key.id
  secret_string = var.initial_model_key_json // blank in plan
}
```
infra-ci: plan attached — no unexpected changes detected, terraform fmt/lint passed.
sam: LGTM from security side if you add the runbook and an explicit rollback (revert to SSM if migration fails). :thumbsup:
linh: one more nit — update kustomize `secretGenerator` refs to the new secretsmanager names; otherwise the controller will try to create k8s secrets from the wrong path.
alex: good catch, will update. PR will have: tf change, kustomize overlay patch, runbook, migration job manifest, and rollout strategy. I'll request reviews from infra and platform. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 (draft).
maria: If infra-ci passes and there are no objections, let's target a maintenance window tomorrow 03:00 UTC for canary start.
alex: noted. I'll schedule the rollout and post an announce in #prod-deploys. No objections, proceeding tomorrow 03:00 UTC unless someone flags.
